parts.text:
According to the current course overload guidelines, students who are not on academic probation and satisfy one of the following criteria may be allowed to overload:

* Students are allowed to overload only when they need 70 or less additional credits to complete all the requirements of their programme.
* Beyond the second semester, any student with a CGPA of 7.5 or higher may be allowed to overload.

Source: Academic_Regulations_Final_03_09_2019, Page 19.
